answer: The delta I would price into every new account is Proof of unique font license purchase: a license bought once and renewed with the same studio, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. What makes this stick is that a license bought once and renewed with the same studio cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the jade of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the tundra is that the farm's unit economics never work.
